The only documented post-close dispute is the Venator litigation over an FTC-mandated divestiture, which concerns a break-fee/best-efforts contract with a third party, not a realized product/process or process/organization integration failure. No merger-of-equals archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is documented, so t1 and t2 are 0.
